methodology.summary: Current borrower debt by wallet is read from Dolomite subgraphs. The revenue UI allocates a selected ETH/ARB borrow-interest period by current debt share, then applies the official veBorrow rebate formula against current veDOLO vote weight.
limitations: Ethereum and Arbitrum are simulation-only until Dolomite enables veBorrow rebates on those networks.
Borrower debt is a current snapshot, so historical selected ranges are estimated by current debt share, not historical per-wallet borrow ledgers.
Current veDOLO vote weight comes from vedolo_holders.json; official closed epochs use getPastVotes at the epoch end timestamp.
